items.title: John Joseph Interview, 1962-01-18
items.q: The mention of Joe Avery occurs entirely within the [INTERVIEWER]'s turn ('He used to play with Joe Avery...'). The [INTERVIEWEE] does not respond to or acknowledge this specific connection, nor does he mention Joe Avery in his own turns.

ctx.x: That man used to play trombone. That's a Foster. That's Dude's brother? That's Dude's brother. That's right. That's Foster Lewis. First time. First time Lewis. Yeah. He used to play trombone. Then he fall back home. At least that was his first instrument. That bass. Then he started playing trombone. He died. He was playing trombone in church. Just before he died. Oh yeah?
Well I didn't know him. I knew Dude. He used to play with Joe Avery until I'm up at Dallas. Come in. How you feel?
Oh hello Eddie. Eddie Summers coming in. What's it? What's it? How's it going? Well we don't want to keep you longer anyway. I think we covered those pictures pretty good I believe.
